description: Wateroverlast - Waterdiepte hoosbui provinciale wegen (2018) is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.zuid-holland.nl. Maximum water depth after storm provincial roads. Calculated using the model instrument 3Di. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Flooding – Water depth hoosbuie provincial roads (2018)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Klimaatatlas, Waterdiepte, Provinciale wegen, Wateroverlast. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2018-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
